title: Cancel an appointment, decline rescheduling, ask about fees
goal: Cancel your upcoming appointment, and only that. Give the date if asked; if you're not sure of it, ask them to look it up. Politely decline offers to reschedule, more than once if they keep offering. End once you have a clear confirmation or clear next steps.
try: Ask whether the cancellation has actually been processed.
Ask whether there's a cancellation fee for short notice.
Ask if they can send you a confirmation by text.
expected: Confirms which appointment before cancelling, cancels it without booking or changing anything else, accepts "no" to rescheduling, gives an honest answer about fees/policy (or says it doesn't know), doesn't promise a text it can't send.
pass_outcome: The patient has an explicit cancellation confirmation, nothing else changed, and an honest answer about fees.

checks.fail_if: Cancels without confirming which appointment, or the wrong one
Makes an unintended change, such as booking a new appointment after the caller declined to reschedule
Keeps pushing to reschedule after two clear declines
States a specific fee or policy it has no basis for, or gives two different answers
Promises a text or email confirmation that the call gives no sign it can send
Ends without a clear "your appointment is cancelled", or says it is cancelled before it found the appointment
